level2.title: The Greatest Commandment
level2.story: A Pharisee who was a lawyer tested Jesus, asking, "Master, which is the great commandment in the law?" Jesus said, "Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with thy whole heart, and with thy whole soul, and with thy whole mind." He said, "This is the greatest and the first commandment." The second is like it: "Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself." Jesus said the whole law and the prophets depend on these two commandments.
